title: About
description: Who we are and what we build.
body: This template is the common foundation for every client website we ship. Fork it, open src/config, edit a few files, and you have a production-ready site.

a.title: First fork
a.body: Shipped a marketing site for a single client and realized the scaffolding deserved to live past the project.

b.title: Config-first rewrite
b.body: Pulled every client-specific string into config + messages files. Three studios forked within a month.

c.title: Open-sourced
c.body: Released under MIT, added the section registry and custom-block escape hatch.
